citations.assessment: Yochanan Chakokaa is named in the account of his return from the villages and report about the grain.
Tosafot explicitly attribute the scribe explanation to Rabbeinu Chananel and the place explanation to Ri. Heilprin adds the comparison with mechokek.
Joshua 19:34 has the place-name. The checked Tosafot explicitly offers the toponym as an alternate explanation.
The Bavli records a man depositing a sack of leaven with Yochanan. The exact folio is 13a. Retain the consulted Rabbi and the received Hebrew reading.

The passage is under 1:4:6 in the checked digital edition. Yose be-Rabbi Bun identifies the unnamed depositor as Yochanan Chikokiya. The following verb has no explicit subject. Preserve the received halakhah number.
